product_summary: Two different web presences use the 'VedaOils' brand and neither page states a legal entity name, so attribution to 'VEDAOILS PRIVATE LIMITED' cannot be confirmed. (1) vedaoils.com — a large B2B/DIY raw-materials catalogue: pure/carrier/essential oils and absolutes (eucalyptus, citrus, spice oils), fragrance oils and designer/agarbatti fragrances, flavour oils, soap bases and melt-and-pour soap, candle waxes/wicks/moulds, cosmetic raw materials (emulsifiers, surfactants, preservatives, butters, floral waters), oleoresins, herbal powders and extracts, clay/fruit-vegetable powders, food additives (preservatives, thickeners, antioxidants, emulsifiers). (2) vedaoils.in — an Ahmedabad (Gota, Gujarat) food-grocery shop, footer 'Copyright © 2026 by VEDA Edible Oils', est. 2025, listing: Veda Groundnut Oil (cold-pressed), A2 Gir Cow Ghee, Krishna Kamod Rice, Veda Moong (green gram), Red Mirchi (chilli) Powder, roasted peanuts. Declared HS 151790 (edible mixtures/preparations of animal/vegetable fats and oils) is only one narrow line and is not the main product of either catalogue.
comment: HS 151790 = 'edible mixtures or preparations of animal/vegetable fats and oils' — matches only a possible blended/ghee-type line; the declared code is a partial fit at best. Correct HS-6 mapping from the catalogues: groundnut oil 151211 (crude) / 151219 (refined); ghee and butter oil 040590 (not 151790); other fixed vegetable oils 151319/151519; essential oils 330129 (incl. spice oils 330190), absolutes 330190; fragrance/flavour oils and agarbatti fragrance 330290/330741; soap bases and soaps 340111/340120; candle waxes 271220/340490; cosmetic raw materials and skincare 330499/382370/3402xx; oleoresins 130219; herbal/clay/fruit powders 121190/130219; rice 100630; green gram 071331; chilli powder 090422; roasted peanuts 120242/200811. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' fits vedaoils.in but badly under-describes vedaoils.com, which is an aromatics/cosmetics-ingredients/soap-and-candle-supplies business — a clear industry misclassification if the declared entity is the .com one. Trader signs: no manufacturing plant, no factory address or capacity published on either site; vedaoils.com sells third-party-style soap bases, waxes, wicks, moulds and packaging supplies (classic reseller/DIY-supply assortment), and vedaoils.in is a small retail pantry shop (self-reported '20+ clients', '1 product type' on its About page) with a gmail contact — both consistent with trading/repacking rather than own production. Product lines missing from the declaration: essential/fragrance/flavour oils, soap and candle supplies, cosmetic raw materials, oleoresins, rice, pulses, spices, peanuts, ghee. All product data here is website/catalogue content only — no customs line, invoice or B-L was reviewed, so every HS mapping above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No registry, revenue or shipment-volume research was done per role scope; CIN/PAN not public on the pages read (null). Recommend confirming which website belongs to the declared legal entity before finalising the HS list.
